decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo without relying on traditional land cards. It uses a variety of cards to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while setting up the win condition of using Goblin Charbelcher to deal direct damage. The deck leverages cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention to quickly find key pieces of the combo and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong board presence. By using a mix of counter spells, removal, and combo pieces, this deck aims to quickly close out the game and secure victory.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently to cast multiple spells in a single turn, leading to a powerful finish with a card like Grapeshot. It utilizes cards like Pyretic Ritual and Desperate Ritual to generate mana, while also including Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Ral, Monsoon Mage for extra value and card advantage. The goal is to set up a strong storm turn and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi Temple and ramp spells to quickly get out powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Thought-Knot Seer. Control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble help to disrupt opponents, while cards like Nulldrifter and Ugin's Labyrinth provide card advantage. Sowing Mycospawn can generate additional threats, and Writhing Chrysalis can turn into a powerful Eldrazi when needed. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats and disruption, while utilizing ramp to get ahead in the mid to late game.

This deck focuses on combining mill cards like Ruin Crab, Hedron Crab, and Archive Trap with control elements like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to quickly deplete the opponent's library. The goal is to get the opponent to draw as many cards as possible, triggering Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Fractured Sanity for massive mill potential. With cards like Surgical Extraction and Field of Ruin for disruption, this deck aims to mill the opponent out as quickly and efficiently as possible while controlling the game.

The deck revolves around the Allosaurus Combo, utilizing cards such as Allosaurus Rider, Neoform, and Eldritch Evolution to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. The deck also includes support cards like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer for protection and consistency. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures before they can react. The deck focuses on efficient mana ramp and search abilities to consistently set up its game-winning plays.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. It aims to control the game by denying the opponent's spells and creatures while gradually building up its own board presence. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus provides threats that can finish the game once the opponent's resources are depleted. The mana base is designed to provide flexibility and consistency in casting the deck's diverse array of spells. Overall, this deck excels at maintaining control of the game and outmaneuvering the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently utilize a combination of cheap countermagic, card draw, and mana ramp to set up an explosive win condition with Goblin Charbelcher. By controlling the game with counterspells and disruption spells, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a lethal Charbelcher activation. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently casting spells and powering out the Charbelcher for a game-winning finish.

This deck focuses on aggressive playstyle by utilizing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy is to efficiently use cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off to apply pressure early in the game, while also utilizing cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge to enhance their creatures and push damage. The deck also includes efficient card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Preordain to maintain momentum and find the right answers. Additionally, Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart provide direct damage to finish off the opponent.

The key concept of this UW Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering spells, removing threats, and controlling the board. The deck focuses on using counterspells like Spell Snare, Counterspell, and Force of Negation to stop the opponent's spells, along with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Wrath of the Skies. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to control the opponent's spells and prevent them from casting at instant speed. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Tune the Narrative, Consult the Star Charts, and Quantum Riddler to ensure the player has the necessary answers to control the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. Utilize cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to put pressure on your opponent early on, while utilizing cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to deal direct damage. Use efficient removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board, and finish off your opponent with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ocelot Pride. The deck aims to be fast and proactive, punishing slower opponents and racing to victory.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and cards that allow you to repeatedly blink them in and out of play. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can protect your creatures and trigger their abilities multiple times. The key strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with constant creature presence and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck aims to outvalue your opponent by generating card advantage through blinking creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Quantum Riddler.

The deck is focused on quickly generating artifacts on the battlefield to take advantage of cards that benefit from having artifacts in play, such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble. By quickly establishing a board presence and utilizing cards like Galvanic Blast and Pinnacle Emissary for additional damage, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of aggressive plays. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Metallic Rebuke and Repeal to provide disruption and control options as needed.

This deck focuses on assembling a combo using creatures that can be searched for with Chord of Calling, while also utilizing tools like Viscera Seer for sacrifice synergy. The toolbox aspect allows for flexibility in finding the right creature for the situation, supported by mana ramp from cards like Gilded Goose. The deck includes a mix of sacrifice outlets, value creatures, and combo pieces to create a powerful and resilient strategy in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities of creatures, disrupting the opponent's strategy while building a board presence. By combining aggressive creatures with cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can control the battlefield and generate card advantage. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push allows the deck to handle threats efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and disruptive tactics.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck includes powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to control the board and protect key threats. Leyline cards provide additional support and synergy within the deck, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offers a potential game-ending combo. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with cheap artifacts and utilizing cards like Urza's Saga to generate value. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts from the graveyard while cards like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast provide card advantage. Cranial Plating and Shadowspear add power to creatures, allowing for aggressive attacks. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of artifact creatures, backed up by disruption from cards like Portable Hole and Tormod's Crypt to control the board and secure victory through damage.
